description.narrative: FMO is providing a USD 10mln “NASIRA” portfolio guarantee with a possibility to top up to USD20 mln within one year of effectiveness. The facility provides credit risk sharing for I&M Rwanda’s MSME portfolio with a focus on MSME loans to women, youth and agriculture clients. With this guarantee in place, FMO will be supporting I&M Rwanda to increase their lending to MSMEs by managing the potential credit risks for the underlying portfolio.
